name: Force Generation Dynamics & Pipeline Latency Holdout Family
description: Tests candidate autonomy predictors under constrained recruit pool elasticity and delayed security training graduation cycles.

experimental_manipulation.rationale: Severe pipeline friction tests whether omega_manpower correctly identifies human capital replacement bottlenecks.

pass_fail_criteria.decision_rule: The frozen discovery predictor must achieve Spearman rho >= 0.60 and MAE <= 0.25 across horizons 30d, 90d, and 180d without refitting.
